weekLabel: Sun Oct 11 cook · Mon Oct 12 – Sun Oct 18
notes: Headcount 5 this week (Rory, Wendy, Chloe + 2 adult guests). Chloe's lunches are just for her; Rory's plate macros unchanged. Everything mild; heat on the side for Rory. Quality: organic; beef grass-fed/finished when possible; chicken air-chilled organic; seafood wild-caught. Rice in bone broth; gelatin in beef. Low oil (spray/air fryer/broth). Named veggie side each night. Macros are estimates.

dinners.name: Chuck roast (first cook night)
dinners.desc: Grass-fed chuck with gelatin, braised carrots, mashed potatoes with bone broth and Greek yogurt; leftovers become Monday's tacos
dinners.side: Shaved fennel-apple slaw — fennel, apple, lemon juice, drizzle of honey, pinch of salt. Thinly slice and toss: 10 min.

dinners.name: Shredded roast tacos
dinners.desc: From Sun Oct 11 chuck roast on corn tortillas, mild salsa, Greek yogurt (or bone broth rice bowls with a fried egg)
dinners.side: Honey-lime cabbage slaw — green + red cabbage, shredded carrot, lime, a little honey, salt. Toss Sunday; keeps 2 days.

dinners.name: Honey cashew chicken
dinners.desc: Air-chilled chicken breast, peppers, broccoli, light honey-garlic-ginger sauce, toasted cashews, over bone broth + cauliflower rice
dinners.side: Smashed cucumber salad — Persian cucumbers, rice vinegar, drops of toasted sesame oil, sesame seeds, salt. Smash, chunk, toss: 5 min.

dinners.name: Cheeseburger bowls
dinners.desc: Extra-lean grass-fed beef (with gelatin), bone broth + cauliflower rice, romaine, tomato, pickles, cheddar, Greek yogurt burger sauce; fried egg optional (+~80 cal, 6g protein)
dinners.side: Air-fryer zucchini fries with parmesan — zucchini spears, avocado-oil spray, garlic powder, grated parmesan. 400°F for 10 min.

dinners.name: Honey-lemon wild salmon
dinners.desc: Wild-caught salmon (air fryer) with bone broth + cauliflower rice (fresh-cooked, ~15 min)
dinners.side: Garlic-lemon roasted asparagus — spray, garlic powder, lemon. 425°F for 8–10 min while the salmon cooks.

dinners.name: Steak night
dinners.side: Garlic green beans with lemon zest — green beans, garlic, broth, lemon. Covered steam-sauté in ¼ cup broth for 6 min.

dinners.name: Greek chicken bowls
dinners.desc: Lemon-oregano chicken breast, bone broth rice, Greek yogurt tzatziki
dinners.side: Cucumber-tomato-red onion salad — cucumber, cherry tomatoes, thin red onion, lemon, dried oregano, salt. 5 min.

dinners.name: Honey-balsamic shredded beef
dinners.desc: Slow-cook anchor: grass-fed chuck, bone broth, gelatin; broth-and-Greek-yogurt mashed potatoes
dinners.side: Honey-dill peas and carrots — frozen peas, diced carrots, broth, a touch of honey, fresh dill. Simmer 6 min.

breakfasts: Egg bites (two trays, ~24): usual Sprouts eggs, cottage cheese, organic chicken breakfast sausage, spinach
Greek yogurt bowls: berries, kiwi, granola; fruit on the side for Chloe
lunches: Grown-up lunches from leftover chicken and beef bowls (scaled for 5)

creami.name: Honey vanilla protein (×2 pints)
creami.desc: Cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla

prep.step: Sear the 4–4.5 lb chuck roast (avocado-oil spray), then slow cooker with carrots, onion, bone broth, gelatin (Sun dinner + Mon tacos). Oven to 425°F. Start a double batch of jasmine rice in bone broth (~3 cups dry).
~4.5 lb chicken breasts on 2–3 parchment pans: garlic-ginger (Tue) and lemon-oregano (Sat).
Chloe's nuggets (egg + seasoned breadcrumbs, light spray), bake or air-fry. Potato wedges on a parchment pan with spray (Mon lunch). Mix the Greek yogurt honey mustard.
Brown ~3 lb extra-lean beef in broth, then stir in bloomed gelatin (Wed).
Honey cashew sauce, burger sauce, tzatziki. Toast cashews (store separately).
Cauliflower rice sautéed in broth, then folded into half the rice. Two trays of egg bites (~24) into the oven.
4 Creami pints blended and frozen (2 honey vanilla, 2 mango-banana).
Cut peppers and broccoli for Tue; shred the honey-lime cabbage slaw for Mon tacos; wash romaine, slice tomatoes and pickles for Wed; cut fruit for Chloe's lunches.
Weigh, portion, label. Freeze Sat's chicken, then move it to the fridge Thu night.
Done. At dinner: broth-and-yogurt mashed potatoes and shaved fennel-apple slaw for 5.

prepNote: Sun Oct 18: honey-balsamic beef goes in the slow cooker that morning; peas and carrots at dinner. First batch cook is Sun Oct 11 (~90–105 min for 5).
